gap: No result ChatGPT got names which charger the maker says to use for each D pick. Tenergy names its T9688 or TN299 for the Centura D 8000mAh. Tenergy's own TN480U charger takes only AA and AAA. Powerex's MH-C801D charger also takes only AA and AAA, so its D cell needs the MH-C808M (2.0 A rapid charge). The 'Tenergy D 10,000mAh' page that ChatGPT retrieved (unranked; the result is listed 13th of 14 in chat 1) is a flat-top pack-building cell, and Tenergy's TN299 charger says it is designed for button-top batteries.
standout_why: I opened New World Survival (2026-09-01, cited) and Reactual (2023-02-20, cited). New World Survival names no charger model. It says only that 'NiMH D cells work with any universal NiMH charger' and recommends 'a smart charger that accepts D cells'. Reactual names no charger and points readers to a separate post. ChatGPT's own answer says only 'Make sure it explicitly supports D-size NiMH cells.' None of them gives a battery-to-charger pairing, charge current or the flat-top versus button-top distinction. I did not open PopSci, The Prepared or Common Sense Home, so I can't say what they contain.
decides: This confirms the Tenergy Centura D as the pick and fixes the bundle. The page should pair it with the Tenergy T9688 or TN299, not the TN480U or TN438 that Dealectric already lists, because the maker's page shows the TN480U takes AA and AAA only. Anyone buying the Tenergy 10,000mAh cell should buy the button-top Premium (P/N 10105), not the flat-top P/N 10103 that ChatGPT retrieved. Anyone buying Powerex D cells needs the MH-C808M, not the MH-C801D.

findings.label: Chargers the maker recommends
findings.value: Tenergy T9688 and TN299; the page says any charger that supports rechargeable D-size NiMH will work
findings.note: Same page: button top, 33 x 61 mm, keeps up to 85% of capacity after 1 year, up to 2,100 recharges. The page gives charge time as capacity divided by charge rate.

findings.label: D-cell support and charge current
findings.value: 4 slots for AA/AAA/C/D in any mix, plus 2 separate 9V channels; AA/C/D charge at 1,300 mA, AAA at 500 mA; NiMH/NiCd; $40.99
findings.source_title: Tenergy T9688 Universal NiMH/NiCd LCD Battery Charger
findings.note: My arithmetic using Tenergy's formula (capacity ÷ rate): 8,000 mAh ÷ 1.3 A ≈ 6.2 h for the Centura D, and 10,000 mAh ÷ 1.3 A ≈ 7.7 h for a 10,000 mAh D. These are nominal times before charging losses.

findings.label: D-cell support and exclusions
findings.value: NiMH/NiCd AAA, AA, C, D and 9V, plus Li-ion/LiFePO4 18650/14500/10400; 4 slots; D charge time 2.25–11.25 h; $45.99
findings.source_title: Tenergy TN299 Hybrid NiMH/NiCd/Li-ion/LiFePO4 Universal Charger
findings.note: The page says it is 'designed to work with button top rechargeable batteries' and excludes flat-top 18650/14500/10400, 26650 cells, alkaline, carbon-zinc, non-rechargeable lithium and 3.0 V RCR123A. It gives no C/D current; the AA rate is 1,000 mA.

findings.product: Tenergy TN480U charger (already listed on Dealectric)

findings.value: AA and AAA only, NiMH; no C or D; 500 mA per AA slot, 250 mA per AAA slot; 5 V 2 A input over USB-C or micro-USB; $23.99
findings.source_title: Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay NiMH Battery LCD Display Fast Charger
findings.note: The page lists 'Compatible Battery sizes: AA, AAA'. Dealectric can't sell this charger as a companion to any D battery.

findings.source_title: Tenergy D 10,000mAh NiMH Flat Top Rechargeable Battery
